text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, exhaust Granny Orne: That investigator fails by either 1 less or 1 more.

name: Mysterious Raven
text: [fast] Discard Mysterious Raven and take 1 horror: Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor:
"And his eyes have all the seeming
of a demon's that is dreaming..."
- Edgar Allan Poe, "The Raven"

name: Scrapper
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: Will to Survive
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Do not reveal chaos tokens for the next skill test you perform this turn.

name: A Test of Will
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, cancel that card's revelation effect.
flavor: With or without hope, all you can do is resist.

name: Grit Your Teeth
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test.
You get +1 to each of your skills for the remainder of the round.

name: Cherished Keepsake
text: Forced - When Cherished Keepsake is defeated by horror: Exile it.
flavor: Mr. Pawterson always told Wendy things would turn out okay. But then again, Mr. Pawterson was a teddy bear, and he didn't know any better.

name: Leather Coat
text: Forced - When Leather Coat is defeated by damage: Exile it.
flavor: The coat was not the most fashionable choice, but it did feel warm and reassuring in its bulk.

name: .18 Derringer
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you fail, place 1 ammo on .18 Derringer and the next time you trigger this ability this round, you get an additional +1 [combat] for that attack.

name: A Test of Will
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, exile A Test of Will.
flavor: With or without hope, all you can do is resist.

name: "Look what I found!"
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.

name: Dumb Luck
text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on the bottom of the encounter deck.
flavor: Fortune favors the oblivious.

name: Unexpected Courage
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return Unexpected Courage to your hand.

name: Granny Orne
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, exhaust Granny Orne: That investigator either gets +1 skill value or -1 skill value for that test.

name: Lucky!
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location would fail a skill test.
They get +3 to their skill value for that test. That investigator draws 1 card.

name: Chainsaw
text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If this attack fails, either place 1 supply on Chainsaw or deal 1 damage to the attacked enemy.

name: Quick Learner
text:
Permanent.
During or before your first action of each of your turns, each skill test you perform gets +1 difficulty.
During or after your third action of each of your turns, each skill test you perform gets -1 difficulty.

name: Déjà Vu
text:
Permanent.
In between two scenarios of a campaign, reduce the experience cost to repurchase up to 3 cards that you exiled during the last scenario by 1 each.
flavor: Haven't you seen this before?

name: Miguel de la Cruz
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which may only be used to play an event.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add a [[Trick]] or [[Trap]] card in your discard pile to your hand.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Miguel's Knapsack, Feline Hybrid, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I'm more at home out in the wild than anywhere else."

name: Miguel's Knapsack
text:
Miguel de la Cruz deck only.
[reaction] When you play an event, exhaust Miguel's Knapsack: Either play that event at a connecting location as if you were at that location, or draw 1 card.

name: Feline Hybrid
text:
Elusive. Hunter. Prey (Miguel de la Cruz only).
Feline Hybrid is immune to player card effects.
flavor: It kills for sport, not for sustenance.

name: Blood Drinker
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Blood Drinker attacks: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Daniel Jameson
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you fail an attack or evasion, exhaust Daniel Jameson: Attempt that skill test again, with +1 skill value.
flavor: "This isn't normal animal fur, I'll tell you that much."

name: Hunting Dog
text: [reaction] When an enemy enters play, exhaust Hunting Dog: Move once toward that enemy's location.
flavor: She'll stay by your side, no matter what.

name: Loner
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Loner: Move to an empty connecting location.
flavor: "I know always that I am an outsider; a stranger in this century and among those who are still men." -H. P. Lovecraft, "The Outsider"

name: Old Compass
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. If you fail, you may exhaust Old Compass to attempt this skill test again.
flavor:
"That thing is bulky, it's cracked, and it's filthy."
"Yeah, but it still points north!"

name: Pocketknife
text: [action]: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may exhaust Pocketknife to gain 1 resource.
flavor: Good for skinning, whittling, and stabbing eldritch abominations in the eye.

name: Same Old Thing
text:
Uses (5 supplies). If there are no supplies on Same Old Thing, discard it.
You may spend supplies on Same Old Thing as resources to pay for events played by any investigator at your location.
flavor: "Just me, a cup of joe, and last night's snuff. I call that a good morning."

name: Decoy Trap
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Decoy Trap: Evade ([intellect] or [agility]). Evade that enemy. You get +1 skill value for this evasion. If this test succeeds, you may discard Decoy Trap to move to this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Glassing
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Glassing: Investigate ([intellect] or [agility]). Investigate attached location. You get +1 skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, you may discard Glassing to discover 1 additional clue at this location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Guerrilla Tactics
text: Fight ([combat]) or Evade ([agility]). You get +1 skill value for this test and you may target an enemy at a connecting location as if you were engaged with that enemy.

name: Hidden Shelter
text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] When the round ends, each investigator at this location may choose one of the following: Draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, heal 1 damage, or heal 1 horror. Forced - After an enemy enters this location: Discard Hidden Shelter.

name: Lie in Wait
text: Fast. Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters this location, exhaust Lie in Wait: Fight ([combat] or [agility]). Fight that enemy. You get +1 skill value for this attack. If you succeed, you may discard Lie in Wait for this attack to deal +1 damage. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Stalk Prey
text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, draw 1 card and discover 1 clue at your location. If that enemy is not at your location, you may move once toward its location.

name: Do-or-Die
text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] asset or event in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor: It's now or never!

name: On the Brink
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return each other card committed to this test to its owner's hand.
flavor: Nobody knows what you'll do if you're pushed past your limits.

name: Extra Rations
text:
Uses (4 supplies). If there are no supplies on Extra Rations, discard it.
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Extra Rations: Heal 1 damage from your investigator or an [[Ally]] asset you control.
flavor: It's not much, but it's enough to keep you going.

name: Field Dressing
text:
Fast. Play after a [[Creature]] or [[Monster]] enemy at your location is defeated.
Heal up to 3 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location.

name: Rough
text: For every 2 damage on you (rounded up), Rough gains [wild].
flavor: Bouncers. Fish people. Monsters. If it's got a pulse, you can sure as hell punch it.

name: Canteen
text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Canteen: Heal 2 horror.
flavor: No matter what you put in it, there's always a faintly bitter taste.

name: Hunter's Instinct
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies). If there are no supplies on Hunter's Instinct, discard it.
[reaction] After you engage an enemy, spend 1 supply and exhaust Hunter's Instinct: Add a level 0-2 event in your discard pile to your hand.

name: Winchester Model 52
text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Discard Winchester Model 52: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, automatically evade the targeted enemy.
flavor: "Shoot it! Don't swing it!"

name: Guerrilla Tactics
text: Fight ([combat]) or Evade ([agility]). You get +2 skill value for this test and you may target an enemy at a connecting location as if you were engaged with that enemy. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to that enemy (in addition to its standard damage).

name: Respite
text:
Play only if there are no enemies at your location.
Choose up to 3 level 0 event and/or skill cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Draw 1 card.

name: Rope Trap
text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] attached. [reaction] When an enemy enters attached location, exhaust Rope Trap: Deal 1 damage to that enemy. Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] token is revealed, discard Rope Trap. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Levelheaded
text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a scenario card). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).

name: Longbow
text: Uses (1 arrow). [action] Spend 1 arrow: Fight ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack. This attack ignores the aloof keyword. [action]: Replenish 1 arrow on Longbow.

name: Makeshift Bomb
text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 [[Trap]] attached. [reaction] After an enemy or investigator enters attached location, discard Makeshift Bomb: Deal 3 damage to each enemy and investigator at that location. (You may trigger this ability from any location.)

name: Timely Intervention
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Timely Intervention from your hand after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test you are performing.
